facts.claim: AIDACosma (AIDA Cruises): Entered service 2021; 183,747 GT; 5440 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 362 m length; Helios class.
AIDAcosma is the second and final Helios-class cruise ship built by Meyer Werft GmbH at Papenburg, Germany under contract from Carnival Corporation for AIDA Cruises.

catalogSpecs.description: Helios-class LNG ship delivered 2021. Features the Ocean Deck with infinity pool and the Fun Park with a rope garden.
